description: Search fresh GTIN products in the catalog your affiliate can deliver (freshness, permissions and caps apply). Requires your affiliate API key in X-API-Key or Bearer authorization; a sandbox key (cw_sbx_, free at partners.clickwise.net/developers) also works and returns example links that never earn. Every key gets exactly the REST GET /api/v1/publisher/products/ format (with gtin: /products/lookup/): products with id, gtin, title, price and currency, url (a Clickwise /dl/ tracked link created for your affiliate the first time a product is returned), image, merchant (id, name and its public website domain), availability, country, brand, category, regular_price, description, size, color and group_id (shared by the sizes of one model and colour), plus count, total and total_exact. Search by text, brand or category, or list one market by country alone; min_price and max_price filter by price in each product's own currency (inclusive, no conversion) and currency keeps one currency; with gtin every market carrying that GTIN is searched; offset paginates.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code: only products priced in this currency (the price range then applies to it).

max_price.description: Inclusive upper price bound, in each product's own currency (no conversion). Number from 0 with up to 4 decimals.

min_price.description: Inclusive lower price bound, in each product's own currency (no conversion). Number from 0 with up to 4 decimals.

name: search_products
title: Search catalog products
